---
name: Deprecation, removal, or replacement request
about: Report an archived, moved, duplicate, unsafe, or inaccurate resource entry
labels: curation, triage
---

## Affected entry

Link the repository file and the resource URL.

## Requested action

Select one: mark as archived or historical; update canonical URL; correct description or claim; merge duplicate; replace with a maintained resource; remove entry.

## Evidence

Provide the upstream notice, canonical source, license/status information, benchmark context, or other public evidence supporting the request.

## Impact on readers

Explain why the current entry may mislead readers about maintenance, provenance, safety, evidence, or authorized use.

## Proposed replacement

If a replacement is appropriate, provide its canonical URL, type, maintainer, license/terms, status, neutral description, and any relevant safety or permission context.
